about: U23 / R31-1: the places where the test stand puts a fake instead of a real component. Convention checked by tests/test_u23_locks.py: a class named Fake*/Stub*/Mock*/Dummy*/Scripted*/*Clock/VirtualLoop/VirtualAsyncio or a function fake_*/stub_* in tests/ or tools/replay/ must be listed (file+name; nested ones count). Entries with by_convention=false are voluntary (the stand scripted parts with other names). Real server, phone, SAPI voice and models live on the laptop; no number from a fake is a measurement.

entries.name: Clock
entries.what: time for fast_text/reserve_text: monotonic() follows the virtual loop, the rest is the real module
entries.why: the always-answer rig runs a whole call in virtual time

entries.name: ScriptedModel
entries.what: the boundary of sherpa-onnx VadModel (silero): window_size/is_speech/reset, verdict k = script[k]
entries.why: the real silero model is not here (laptop only), and sherpa exits the whole process on a wrong window size, so the fake records such calls

entries.name: FakeClock
entries.what: a hand-advanced clock (a callable or object with now/monotonic) injected instead of time.monotonic/time.time
entries.why: the test moves time by hand: exact timings are asserted with no sleep, and no number from it is a laptop or phone measurement

entries.name: FakeSource

entries.why: no real model call in tests; the test reads what the product sent

entries.name: FakeBridge
entries.what: the Conduit Watch helper pipe (start/send/receive/close like ThreadedHelperBridge)
entries.why: fault injection: a corrupt pipe, EOF and a timeout on demand

entries.name: FakeSearchModule

entries.why: no network search here; the plan says what a lookup returns or raises
